parsed.explanation: No trans-specific offence; the 2022 supreme court ruling decriminalised same-sex conduct against official resistance and read sex discrimination to include gender identity — evidence of functioning, rights-respecting courts, a strong climate signal. Nothing documented targets trans visitors: no presentation law, no facility/birth-sex rule, no police sweeps, no visitor-facing extortion; the single pre-2022 assault is a dated isolated incident. Absences that matter (no legal gender recognition, no anti-discrimination statute, no relationship recognition) are resident-facing gaps, not visitor exposures, and are lightest-weight. Conversely, silence is not safety here: border/document practice with foreign markers, custody placement, ward practice and emergency care are undocumented open questions, and no working visitor remedy or social-acceptance research is recorded. Decriminalisation plus functioning courts but no demonstrated protections places it below the 0.75 tier of documented, operating remedies.
